mainEntity.name: What is a cybersecurity PR agency and is a fractional operator a better fit?

acceptedAnswer.text: A cybersecurity PR agency runs analyst relations, media outreach, threat-research amplification and crisis communications for security companies. For most funded startups, a fractional senior operator is the better fit because the person who builds analyst relationships and pitches security editors is the same person you hired, not a junior account executive. Shilika Jain runs cybersecurity PR directly for $5K–$12K/month.

mainEntity.name: How much does cybersecurity PR cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Full-service cybersecurity agencies commonly charge $15K–$45K per month because the retainer funds a multi-person team covering media, analyst relations and content separately. A fractional senior operator delivers the same senior scope for $5K–$12K per month, and a launch sprint for a product release or CVE disclosure runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets and analysts can you actually reach?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 security press: Dark Reading, SC Media, SecurityWeek, Wired, Ars Technica security desk, MIT Technology Review. Mainstream where the angle warrants it: Forbes, Bloomberg, Benzinga, AI Magazine. Analyst firms: Gartner, Forrester and IDC briefings arranged and prepped directly. Coverage and analyst access depend on a credible security claim, not a wire blast.

mainEntity.name: What does the process and timeline look like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Week one is an audit of your current press footprint and analyst coverage gaps. Week two to three is narrative and category positioning. From week four, tier-1 outreach, analyst briefings and threat-research placements run in parallel. A full retainer engagement typically shows first tier-1 placements within six to eight weeks, with sustained coverage and AI-citation tracking continuing monthly.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with cybersecurity PR?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a short project brief through the intent form and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your current press footprint and analyst coverage, or book a 30-minute call to map it live. No deck required, no account-team intro call.
